entries.name: A Warlock's Services
entries.snippet: **When you use Blood Sorcery or occult expertise to solve a problem for someone outside your Coterie**, you automatically create a Debt over them. Coterie members start each owing you 1 Debt for services "freely" rendered.

entries.name: Arbiter's Eyes
entries.snippet: **When you *Discern Vibes* or *Catch the Scent* to determine if someone has recently committed a crime or transgression**, you have Advantage on the roll.

entries.name: Arcane Appraisal
entries.snippet: **You can identify the presence and general nature of supernatural effects, Blood Sorcery, active Disciplines, wards, and curses without rolling.** Specifics (who, when, parameters) require **Catch the Scent** or Discipline use.

entries.name: Barely a Beast
entries.snippet: **You never Frenzy from Hunger alone.** At 5 Hunger, retain full control but have Disadvantage on all rolls except **Hunt** and **Feed**. Supernatural effects and Discipline Powers can still provoke Frenzy.

entries.name: Beast's Leash
entries.snippet: **When the Beast rises due to Hunger or mundane effects**, you can choose to Frenzy voluntarily instead of **Staying Chill**. You retain control: choose your target, avoid Harming your Coterie, and remember everything. Bane penalty is only -1 regardless of BP. Afterwards, gain +1 Hunger (max 4).

entries.name: Borrowed Time
entries.snippet: **When you consume Vitae from your patron** (they gain +1 Hunger, you slake normally), choose: heal Sup. or Agg. Harm equal to {{patron-bp}}, or gain Advantage on {{patron-bp}} Discipline rolls until you sleep.

entries.name: Brutality
entries.snippet: **When you inflict Harm through hands-on violence** (fists, claws, melee weapons, thrown objects, etc.), add {{bp@min:1}} to the Harm dealt.

entries.name: Center of Gravity
entries.snippet: **When you are the focus of attention in a social scene**, all non-Coterie characters (except Elders) take -1 Ongoing to notice anything that isn't you. No roll needed; lasts as long as you're actively engaging the crowd.

entries.name: Death's Confidant
entries.snippet: **When you encounter a corpse or sense a ghost's presence**, ask it 1 question and receive a truthful (if cryptic) answer without rolling. Anything beyond requires Discipline use.

entries.name: Duskborn
entries.snippet: **You can walk in sunlight** (take 1 Sup. Harm/scene of sustained exposure; reducible). You always count as having **Blush of Life** active at no cost. You can eat, drink, use touchscreens, and pass medical exams.

entries.name: Face of Horror
entries.snippet: **When you deliberately reveal your true form to intimidate or terrify**, roll **Influence** with Advantage using your highest stat; ignore your Bane penalty for that roll. Unprepared mortals flee or freeze.

entries.name: Gift of Apis
entries.snippet: **Animal blood nourishes you as effectively as human blood regardless of BP.** Ignore all BP-related **Feeding** restrictions from animals. Animals never have Resonance. You may select the Farmer Predator Type at any BP.

entries.name: In Harmony
entries.snippet: **1/Scene, when you successfully use any Melpominee Power**, one ally who can hear you takes +1 Forward. If other Daughters participate, bonus extends to all allies who hear you; you take +1 Ongoing to Melpominee per participating Daughter (max +3) until you stop/scene ends.

entries.name: Indomitable
entries.snippet: **When you *Stay Chill* to resist supernatural coercion or commands from other Kindred**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Infectious Insight
entries.snippet: **When you share info from *Discern Vibes* or *Catch the Scent* with a Coterie member and they act on it**, they take +1 Forward.

entries.name: Just a Taste
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from a vampire**, temporarily gain 1 of their Disciplines (your choice), its Perk, and all its level 1 Powers. Lasts until you slumber or reach 5 Hunger.

entries.name: Living Rampart
entries.snippet: **When you *Protect the Coterie***, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**. You ignore the 1/Scene usage limit. On **7–9**, protect yourself plus one ally within Close Range.

entries.name: Lucky Devil
entries.snippet: **1/Session, you can reroll any single roll you've just made**, and take either result.

entries.name: Mending Touch
entries.snippet: **1/Scene, heal 2 Sup. or 1 Agg. Harm on a willing creature via physical contact** (no roll). Sup. costs +1 Hunger; Agg. costs +2 Hunger.

entries.name: Muse's Gift
entries.snippet: **1/Session, you can spend a quiet moment with a willing character to inspire them.** They gain Advantage on their next roll aligned with the emotional tone. If it's a Coterie member and the roll succeeds, you both gain +1 XP.

entries.name: Phantom Trick
entries.snippet: You can conjure brief, minor sensory illusions at will (wrong-direction sound, peripheral movement, phantom scent). **When you weave one into any Move as a distraction**, take +1 Forward. They dissolve under direct scrutiny.

entries.name: Pillar of Osiris
entries.snippet: **You can designate a location as your Pillar** (1 full night of meditation). While there: +1 Ongoing to Bardo Powers and **Stay Chill**. Meditating for 1 full scene removes 1 Stain. Must return 1/week; each week away, take cumulative -1 Ongoing to **Stay Chill** (reset by meditating for 1 scene).

entries.name: Playing Possum
entries.snippet: **When another Kindred dismisses you as beneath notice or harmless**, immediately ask the Storyteller 1 question from **Discern Vibes** or **Catch the Scent** about them without rolling or spending Hold.

entries.name: Provider of Last Resort
entries.snippet: **When you give someone something they genuinely need and can't easily get elsewhere**, you automatically gain a Debt over them (they may not know).

entries.name: Psychic Predator
entries.snippet: **You are not a vampire.** You **Feed** on ephemera from mortals and spirits (not Kindred). Walk in daylight, pass as human, never Frenzy (unless forced by Powers). Cannot eat/drink or use **Blush of Life**. You can roll +Wits wherever +Blood is called for. At 5 Hunger you fade: lose Discipline access & have Disadvantage on all rolls except **Hunt** and **Feed**.

entries.name: Pulling Strings
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* someone you have a Debt with** (in either direction), or a mortal while you're both in darkness, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Resonant Voice
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* someone through direct speech, song, or vocalization**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Righteous Hunger
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from someone you believe genuinely deserves punishment**, slake 1 additional Hunger. If you successfully Diablerize them, lose no Humanity and clear all Stains.

entries.name: Sanguine Sommelier
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* a mortal's emotional state**, you can shift their Blood Resonance to match the emotion you're cultivating (takes a few minutes). **When a Kindred *Feeds* from that mortal**, they get the Resonance you set.

entries.name: Scrappy
entries.snippet: **You cannot have a negative modifier to any roll for any reason other than Hunger.** The worst you can do is add nothing.

entries.name: Scrupulous Sentinel
entries.snippet: **When you are within your Haven or with your treasure and acting to defend/maintain/control it**, treat any **6-** as a **7–9**. Does not apply elsewhere, even if you carry your treasure with you.

entries.name: Sculptor's Claws
entries.snippet: You can reshape your own physical features (skin, bone, coloring, height, build) over an uninterrupted scene without rolling. Changes are permanent until reshaped. **When you reveal a monstrous alteration to intimidate**, roll **Influence** with Advantage.

entries.name: Serpent's Tongue
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* someone by appealing to a desire/vice/need they're suppressing**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Shadow's Embrace
entries.snippet: **When you *Slip Away* and shadows are available**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Sharpened Senses
entries.snippet: **You always sense mundane and supernatural creatures within Close Range** (even in darkness/while blinded) without rolling. **When you *Catch the Scent* to track prey or detect danger**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Soul Sight
entries.snippet: **When you *Discern Vibes* on an entity**, you may ask "What is their current Humanity?", "Do they intend to harm me?", or "Are they concealing their true nature?" without spending Hold.

entries.name: Still Kicking
entries.snippet: **Your BP is 0 and you're alive.** Heartbeat, body heat, digestion, sunlight, pass medical exams. No **Blush of Life** needed (or possible). Must be nice.

entries.name: Stone Hide
entries.snippet: **You have always-active {{bp@min:1}}-Armor.** Unlike other Armor, this also reduces Agg. Harm.

entries.name: Tactical Command
entries.snippet: **1/Scene, when you give a direct order to an ally in a tense situation and they follow it**, they gain Advantage and +1 Forward on the roll to execute it.

entries.name: The Cobweb
entries.snippet: **1/Session, you can ask the Storyteller a single yes-or-no question about anything in the past, present, or imminent future**. The answer is always truthful but arrives filtered through your affliction (visions, whispers, sensations).

entries.name: The Warrens
entries.snippet: **When you *Catch the Scent* regarding anything happening in your territory**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Unshackled Servant
entries.snippet: **You have no Beast, no Pred. Type, and never Frenzy** (unless forced by Powers). **Stay Chill** still applies for stress/coercion, never for rampage. At 5 Hunger, enter withdrawal: lose Discipline access & have Disadvantage on all rolls except **Feed**.

entries.name: Unyielding Privilege
entries.snippet: **When you *Stay Chill* to resist coercion, mental domination, or intimidation from any source**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Wages of Pain
entries.snippet: **When you successfully *Feed* from a living vessel**, slake 1 additional Hunger. This can drop you below the Hunger floor imposed by high BP.

entries.name: Adversarial Aesthetics
entries.snippet: **When your surroundings are aesthetically hostile** (filthy, institutional, very bland), take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all Resolve and Discipline rolls. Storyteller determines based on your personal aesthetic.

entries.name: Agonizing Empathy
entries.snippet: **Whenever your *Feeding* causes Harm to the vessel**, you suffer the same amount as Agg. Harm, up to {{bp@min:1}} max. Manifests as vivid internal bruising at the bite location.

entries.name: Agonizing Kiss
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from a living vessel**, your Kiss is agony, not ecstasy. Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to **Feed** rolls unless vessel is restrained/unconscious/willing. All living vessels you **Feed** from take 1 Sup. Harm regardless.

entries.name: Asceticism
entries.snippet: **When your Hunger is ≤2**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all Discipline rolls. Only starvation unlocks your Vitae's full potential. (Third eye still bleeds & you're still delicious, though.)

entries.name: Blood Bound
entries.snippet: **You are Blood Bound to your patron.** They can Cash In your Debt {{patron-bp}} times without depleting it, and Invoke it {{patron-bp}} times per night. Cannot be refused/erased/transferred. Ends only via Embrace or patron's Final Death.

entries.name: Built to Serve
entries.snippet: **You cannot pass as mortal.** Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to social rolls with unfamiliar/hostile characters who see you (stationary in architecture = assumed statue). Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to **Stay Chill** vs. mental coercion (-{{bp*2}} vs. Tremere). Humanity cap: 6.

entries.name: Burning Blood
entries.snippet: **When you witness a direct violation of your Convictions**, immediately **Stay Chill** at -{{bp@min:1}}. On **6-**, enter a furious Frenzy targeting the source; can't stop until they're incapacitated/dead/driven off or you're restrained.

entries.name: Callousness
entries.snippet: **When you make a Remorse Check**, roll with Disadvantage. The Beast eats your guilt before you can feel it.

entries.name: Cold-Blooded
entries.snippet: You can only use **Blush of Life** if you've **Fed** from a living vessel in the current or previous scene. **When you do**, make {{bp@min:1}} Hunger Checks instead of 1. If any would bring you to 5 Hunger, **Blush of Life** fails and you stabilize at 4.

entries.name: Cursed Courtesy
entries.snippet: **You cannot willingly enter a private residence unless invited.** Forcing entry: gain +1 Hunger and take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all Discipline rolls for the duration. Public/abandoned buildings unaffected; apartments count as separate residences. Cannot take the *Invitations* Folkloric Bane.

entries.name: Decay
entries.snippet: **When you move into your Coterie's Haven**, distribute -1 to Coterie stats for each Touchstone you have (no stat below -3). If a Touchstone visits the Haven, lose them permanently and mark 1 Stain, but remove that -1 penalty. New Touchstones during play assign a new -1 immediately.

entries.name: Defanged Blood
entries.snippet: **Your Vitae cannot Blood Bond other Kindred.** You can still be Bound by others. Can still Blood Bond mortals/Ghouls/animals, but requires {{bp@min:1}} additional **Feedings** beyond the normal 3.

entries.name: Denied Beast
entries.snippet: **When you Frenzy**, the starved Beast erupts. Take -{{osirian-penalty}} Ongoing to **Stay Chill** for the rest of the night. You also cannot Embrace anyone; attempts simply kill the mortal.

entries.name: Diablerist's Thirst
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from another vampire**, you must **Stay Chill** or enter a feeding Frenzy and try to drain them. **7+** to resist, then take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to continue resisting (3 successes ends it).

entries.name: Diluted & Disliked
entries.snippet: **Your BP is 0 and cannot increase** (except via Diablerie). You take Agg. Harm from blades/bullets/sources that are only Sup. for full Kindred. Cannot create Blood Bonds. Embrace attempts usually kill the mortal. Storyteller may apply -1 to -2 Forward on social rolls with Kindred.

entries.name: Distorted Image
entries.snippet: **When you interact with technology or electronic devices**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing. Mirrors warp, cameras distort, surveillance corrupts. At BP 3+, touchscreens and voice-activated devices are unusable; **Blush of Life** doesn't help.

entries.name: Doomed to Wander
entries.snippet: **You cannot sleep in the same location more than 1/week** (1+ mile apart to count). Violating this: take 1 Agg. Harm (2 at BP 3+). Applies in Torpor. Mobile Havens are safe if parked differently each day.

entries.name: Dragon's Tether
entries.snippet: **You must slumber within/around your treasure each day.** Resting away: take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to Resolve rolls until you return. Cumulative per consecutive day away (max -{{bp*2}}).

entries.name: Fractured Perception
entries.snippet: **You have a supernatural affliction** (defined at creation). When the Beast presses in (Hunger 4+, Frenzy, **6-** on **Stay Chill**, etc.), take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to **Discern Vibes** and **Catch the Scent** until pressure eases/scene ends. Storyteller may introduce 1 false detail while active that you believe is true.

entries.name: Hierarchy
entries.snippet: **When you use a Discipline Power against a Kindred with higher BP than yours**, roll with Disadvantage. To physically attack such a Kindred, first **Stay Chill** or find yourself unable to raise a hand. Failure means no violence against them for the scene (unless they start it).

entries.name: Holy Symbols
entries.snippet: **Being within 2 Ranges of a holy symbol** (you select which apply) deals 2 Agg. Harm/round. Within 1 Range: 3-Harm. Physical contact: 5-Harm. (+3 XP)

entries.name: Holy Water
entries.snippet: Touching holy water deals 1 Agg. Harm. Drinking it causes Final Death. Why would you do that? (+1 XP)

entries.name: Hunted Blood
entries.snippet: **You have a third eye on your forehead**; physical coverings work, no supernatural Power can hide it. Opens and weeps blood when you use Active Powers. Nearby Kindred at 4+ Hunger must **Stay Chill** or try to **Feed** from you. Non-Salubri who taste your blood must **Stay Chill** at -{{bp@min:1}} or keep going; Blood Leeches have Disadvantage.

entries.name: Infestation
entries.snippet: Vermin follow you constantly and infest any enclosed space you inhabit. Everyone in your Haven (including you) takes -2 Ongoing to social rolls & anything requiring patience/focus. At other enclosed locations where you spend ≥1 scene, -1 Ongoing to the same. Animalism attempts on the vermin have Disadvantage.

entries.name: Inner Song
entries.snippet: **You always hear music no one else can.** Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all Wits rolls (always active). In loud/overstimulating environments, also applies to **Stay Chill**. In total silence, **Stay Chill** or trigger Compulsion. On any **12+** Wits roll, penalty doesn't apply.

entries.name: Invitations
entries.snippet: **You are physically unable to enter any private building** unless invited by someone with sufficient authority. (+2 XP)

entries.name: Lacking Lineage
entries.snippet: **You carry no supernatural curse, but Kindred society stigmatizes you.** Storyteller may apply -1 to -2 Forward on Demeanor rolls with Kindred who know. Discipline XP costs: +{{bp@min:1}} to unlock access; +{{(bp/2)@roundup}} for non-starter Powers.

entries.name: Mark of the Beast
entries.snippet: **When you Frenzy**, your body gains {{bp@min:1}} bestial features. Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to social rolls with unfamiliar characters until you sleep. Cannot be concealed by mundane means; doesn't stack from multiple Frenzies per night.

entries.name: Monstrous Visage
entries.snippet: **You cannot pass as mortal by any usual means.** Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to social rolls with characters who see your true form and are unfamiliar/hostile. Also applies to supernatural disguises (Obfuscate, etc.).

entries.name: Noxious Blood
entries.snippet: **Your Vitae is poison**. Any creature who drinks it takes {{bp@min:1}} Agg. Harm per instance. Your Vitae cannot heal mortal injuries. Creating a Ghoul or Blood Bond requires the mortal to survive this damage each time they drink (most don't).

entries.name: Noxious Garlic
entries.snippet: Touching garlic deals 1 Agg. Harm. Eating it deals 3 Agg. Harm but sets Hunger to 0 and prevents **Feeding** until next night. (+1 XP)

entries.name: Pale Beasts
entries.snippet: **When you see an all-white animal**, **Stay Chill** with Disadvantage or flee the scene at once. (+1 XP)

entries.name: Rarefied Palate
entries.snippet: **You have an exclusive *Feeding* preference**, and blood outside it provides zero sustenance. Roll +Wits in close proximity to sense a match (**7+** = certain). At BP 3+, restriction narrows further (define with Storyteller).

entries.name: Running Water
entries.snippet: **You are physically unable to cross running water** (streams, rivers, sewer pipes, aqueducts, garden hoses). Bodies of water (ponds, lakes, oceans) don't trigger this. (+2 XP)

entries.name: Searing Silver
entries.snippet: **Touching silver** deals 2 Agg. Harm. If incorporated into a weapon, all its damage is Agg. (+2 XP)

entries.name: Severe Light Allergy
entries.snippet: **When you are exposed to bright, direct light** (spotlights, high beams, harsh fluorescents), take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls. Sunlight deals +{{bp}} extra Agg. Harm on top of normal effects. Candles/dim lamps/ambient glow don't trigger this.

entries.name: Stake Bait
entries.snippet: **Being staked through the heart** causes instant Final Death instead of incapacitation. Oops! (+3 XP)

entries.name: Stigmata
entries.snippet: **When at ≥4 Hunger**, you bleed from wounds on your hands, feet, and forehead. They never heal. While bleeding: Disadvantage on all Demeanor rolls and a walking Masquerade violation. (+3 XP)

entries.name: Stolen Blood
entries.snippet: **When you Blood Surge**, make {{bp@min:1}} additional Hunger Checks on top of the normal one. If any would bring you to 5 Hunger, choose to cancel the Surge (keep gained Hunger, max 4) or complete it and immediately Frenzy at 5.

entries.name: Survival Instincts
entries.snippet: **When you *Stay Chill* against fear** (fire, sunlight, genuine survival threats), roll with Disadvantage. Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls until you are guaranteed safe from whatever triggered it. Your Beast would rather run than fight.

entries.name: The Wasting
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from the same mortal more than once**, start a 6-segment Wasting Clock. Each **Feeding** advances {{1+bp}} segments. Fades 1 segment/week of no contact. Full Clock = their decline becomes impossible to hide.

entries.name: Unbirth Name
entries.snippet: You have a secret mortal name you cannot forget. Anyone who learns it gains a Debt over you. **If they speak it to your face**, they gain Advantage to resist your Discipline Powers for the scene, and you have Disadvantage to resist theirs.

entries.name: Unnatural Manifestations
entries.snippet: **When you use any Discipline Power in the presence of mortals**, they're deeply unsettled for the scene. Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to social rolls with those mortals (except intimidation). Kindred recognize you as a vampire but suffer no ill effects.

entries.name: UV Light
entries.snippet: **When exposed to UV light from sources other than the sun**, take 3 Agg. Harm/round of contact. (+3 XP)

entries.name: Violence
entries.snippet: **When you have ≥3 Hunger and deal Harm to anyone**, the Beast demands you slay them. You must keep attacking until they're dead or you successfully **Stay Chill**. Killing this way marks 2 Stains (unless aligned with Convictions).

entries.name: Affective Empathy
entries.snippet: **When you perceive genuine suffering in someone nearby**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to helping them. Ends when you meaningfully alleviate their pain/a more immediate crisis supersedes/scene ends.

entries.name: Arrogance
entries.snippet: **When a situation seems leaderless or poorly handled**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to establishing yourself as the authority. Ends when someone obeys a genuine direct order from you (no technicalities)/scene ends.

entries.name: Cacophony
entries.snippet: **When surrounding sounds clash with your Inner Song**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to performing or using Melpominee. Ends when the sonic environment aligns with your Inner Song/scene ends.

entries.name: Covetousness
entries.snippet: **When you become aware of something valuable or desirable to you in the scene**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to acquiring it. Ends when you establish ownership/it becomes unattainable/scene ends.

entries.name: Cryptophilia
entries.snippet: **When you suspect someone nearby is hiding a secret**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to uncovering information. Ends when you learn a secret significant enough to be useful/scene ends.

entries.name: Dark Devotion
entries.snippet: **When your patron expresses displeasure or your position feels threatened**, take -{{patron-bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not working toward earning their approval. Ends when you perform meaningful service/threat passes.

entries.name: Delusion
entries.snippet: **When you catch a detail or pattern others overlook**, you become convinced it's the most important thing happening. Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to chasing it until you investigate to your satisfaction/scene ends.

entries.name: Feelings Fixation
entries.snippet: **When you sense intense emotion from someone nearby**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not working toward reaching them to **Feed**. Ends when you make prolonged contact/scene ends.

entries.name: Feral Impulses
entries.snippet: **When someone directly challenges your strength or competence in front of others**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls involving reason, logic, or social grace. Ends when you physically establish dominance/scene ends.

entries.name: Intervention
entries.snippet: **When you witness cruelty or someone succumbing to base urges**, take -{{osirian-penalty}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to peaceful intervention. Violence to resolve this marks 1 Stain. Ends when you de-escalate/scene ends.

entries.name: Judgment
entries.snippet: **When someone violates one of your Convictions/personal codes in your presence**, you must drink their blood as punishment. Until you do/scene ends, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls except ones made to punish them.

entries.name: Morbidity
entries.snippet: **When you encounter death or the boundary between it and life**, you must transform something's state (kill, resurrect, conclude, rekindle). Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all other rolls until you do/scene ends.

entries.name: Obsession
entries.snippet: **When something of extraordinary beauty captures your attention**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls unrelated to the fixation. If someone redirects you, **Stay Chill** or become entranced (can't act until physically snapped out). Ends when you can't perceive it/scene ends.

entries.name: Perfectionism
entries.snippet: **When you fail to meet your own standards**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls until you achieve a **12+** on any roll/scene ends. Repeating a previously-attempted action reduces the penalty by 1 (from BP → 0).

entries.name: Rebellion
entries.snippet: **When you feel under authority/control you didn't agree to**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not working toward defiance. Ends when you meaningfully rebel/scene ends.

entries.name: Ruthlessness
entries.snippet: **When you fail any roll (**6-**)**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls except pursuing the failed objective. Ends when you succeed/it becomes impossible/scene ends.

entries.name: Tempting Fate
entries.snippet: **When a problem has both a safe and risky solution**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to cautious/conventional rolls. Committing to the riskiest option ends it; take +1 Ongoing until your plan resolves.

entries.name: The Vigil
entries.snippet: **When you perceive a direct threat to your Haven, Flock, or someone you've sworn to protect**, take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not dedicated to defending your charge. You cannot voluntarily retreat while active. Ends when you interpose yourself/neutralize the danger/scene ends.

entries.name: Transgression
entries.snippet: **When you recognize a taboo or moral boundary someone holds sacred**, you must test it. Take -{{bp@min:1}} Ongoing to all rolls not working toward enticing someone into violating a Conviction (causing 1+ Stain) or personal tenet/scene ends.

entries.name: 2-for-1 Special
entries.snippet: **When you successfully subdue fresh prey and bring them to your location to *Feed***, one other vampire can drink the runoff and slake 2 Hunger without rolling.

entries.name: Abyssal Sustenance
entries.snippet: **When you successfully *Hunt* while completely concealed in deep shadow**, slake 1 Hunger before you even **Feed**.

entries.name: Adoring Fans
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* among your established herd**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**, or a **7–9** as a **10+**.

entries.name: Bring Me a Dream
entries.snippet: **When you *Slip Away* to approach sleeping prey or leave afterwards**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Burner Accounts
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* using dating apps or social platforms**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Cadaveric Snap
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* via your cadaveric spasm**, no roll is needed if an animal wanders close enough. Alternatively, roll 1d6 every slumber and decrease Hunger by half that amount (rounded down).

entries.name: Cold Indifference
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from blood bags**, slake 2 Hunger instead of 1.

entries.name: Collector's Eye
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* by tracking a collector or buyer**, you automatically locate them without rolling. You always know who currently possesses your artwork.

entries.name: Come Closer
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* by luring prey into a dark or isolated location**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Competitive Edge
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* in direct competition with your rival**, take +2 Forward. If you **Feed** before they do, slake 1 extra Hunger.

entries.name: Crisis of Faith
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* or *Hunt* someone who is devoutly religious**, take +1 Forward. Amen, babe.

entries.name: Dastardly Doolittle
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* for animal prey in an area where animals are present**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Devil's Due
entries.snippet: You start with 2 Debts owed to you by mortals or Kindred who have entered agreements with you.

entries.name: Devoted Watcher
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* or *Catch the Scent* in the vicinity of your obsession target**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Fetch!
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* with your animal's assistance**, roll with Advantage. Remember treats & pats!

entries.name: Grave Sense
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* or *Catch the Scent* to locate dying prey**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Guest List
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* at an event you organized or are hosting**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**. Your Coterie gains +1 Ongoing to **Influence** first-time guests while in attendance.

entries.name: Hot Tea
entries.snippet: **When you successfully *Discern Vibes* or *Catch the Scent* within your subculture**, gain +1 extra Hold.

entries.name: I Don't Bite
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* by luring prey to your established location**, ask "What would make them feel safest here?" or "How can I get them to trust me?" If you incorporate the answer, take +1 Ongoing until you've **Fed**.

entries.name: I Know a Guy
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* criminals, dealers, fences, or street-level operatives**, take +1 Ongoing until your problem is resolved.

entries.name: Iron Gullet
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from fresh human corpses** (dead <48 hours), slake 2 Hunger instead of 1. You suffer no ill effects from diseased, drugged, or tainted blood.

entries.name: Jolly Cooperation
entries.snippet: **When someone else successfully *Hunts* to find prey for you**, take +1 Forward when you **Feed** from that vessel. **When the Coterie uses *Sate Your Hunger***, treat your **6-** as a **7–9**, or a **7–9** as a **10+**.

entries.name: Just a Wee B&E
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* in another Kindred's territory**, take +1 Forward. What a rush!

entries.name: Kindred Sense
entries.snippet: You can identify most other vampires on sight, even if they're using **Blush of Life**. **When you *Catch the Scent* to detect vampires or their activities**, take +1 Forward.

entries.name: Know Thine Enemy
entries.snippet: **When you *Catch the Scent* or *Discern Vibes* to locate or assess Hunters**, take +1 Forward.

entries.name: Load-Bearing Lunch
entries.snippet: **When you successfully *Discern Vibes* about a workplace, business, or service**, you may ask "Who here would cause the most disruption if they went missing?"

entries.name: Long Haul
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* along roads, highways, or rest areas**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Moral Compass
entries.snippet: **When you *Catch the Scent* or *Discern Vibes* to read a mortal's character**, you automatically know whether they've committed a serious crime or act of cruelty within the last month.

entries.name: New in Town
entries.snippet: You can identify outsiders, travelers, and newcomers in your territory without rolling. **When you *Hunt* within your established territory**, you always know whether viable transient prey is present before committing.

entries.name: One More Favor
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* a Kindred to share their meal or provide you with a vessel**, take +1 Forward.

entries.name: Paralytic Dread
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from a sleeping or resting target**, they cannot cry out or resist, and remember the experience only as a nightmare.

entries.name: Pillow Talk
entries.snippet: **When you *Discern Vibes* about someone you're romantically pursuing**, take +1 Forward and +1 extra Hold on a success (7+).

entries.name: Plausible Deniability
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* by sending your animals out**, you never need to be present and your prey never sees your face.

entries.name: Plus One
entries.snippet: **When you *Slip Away* into or out of a social gathering you weren't invited to**, roll with Advantage. An ally you bring also gets this Advantage if you both meet the dress code.

entries.name: Power Dynamics
entries.snippet: **When you *Discern Vibes* about someone in a position of authority or influence**, you may ask "What is the foundation of their confidence?" or "What would humiliate them most?"

entries.name: Protection Racket
entries.snippet: You start with 3 Debts owed to you by mortals or Kindred who have entered agreements with you.

entries.name: Regular Deliveries
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* from your established position of authority**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Right Where It Hurts
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* someone by insulting, belittling, or humiliating them**, take +1 Forward.

entries.name: Savoring the Kill
entries.snippet: **When you complete a full feast** (meeting your {{bp}}-scene & vessel requirements), choose any Intense Blood Resonance from among your vessels and gain the associated Advantages for free.

entries.name: Scathing Review
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* someone or *Discern Vibes* about them by critiquing their work or creative output**, take +1 Forward.

entries.name: Scouted Exit
entries.snippet: **When you *Slip Away* after subduing prey**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Second Amendment
entries.snippet: You start with an untraceable firearm (3-Harm or less) with the Concealed and Reliable tags. You love it.

entries.name: Secrets of the Flock
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* through confession or pastoral counsel**, you may ask "What are they most guilty about?" or "Which secret would destroy them?"

entries.name: Self-Sustaining
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* by harvesting from your spawning pool**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Squatter's Rights
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* or *Feed* inside a structure you've been nesting in for at least a week**, roll with Advantage.

entries.name: Starving Artists
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* among artists or creatives you patronize**, you automatically find a willing meal without rolling.

entries.name: Tithe & Tribute
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* by collecting the neighborhood tribute**, treat a **6-** as a **7–9**.

entries.name: Touch-Starving
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* during or immediately after intimate physical contact**, you may also heal 1 Sup. Harm. Your bite is intensely pleasurable for the recipient.

entries.name: Trusted Circle
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* within your established circle** (family, close friends, dependents), you automatically find suitable prey without rolling.

entries.name: Tunnel Rat
entries.snippet: **When you *Slip Away* underground**, roll with Advantage. Given enough time, you can travel between almost any two locations in the city without surfacing (Storyteller willing).

entries.name: Unnatural Selection
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* carefully** (spending ≥1 scene observing), ask the Storyteller: "Are they dangerous?", "Will anyone miss them?", or "Are they being watched by anyone else?"

entries.name: Untraceable
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt***, you never risk a Masquerade breach from the act of **Feeding** itself. It's gross, though.

entries.name: Willing Donors
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from a willing, consenting vessel**, choose 1 additional option from the **10+** list (even on a **7–9**).

entries.name: Aristocratic Rivalry
entries.snippet: Another Kindred is actively poaching your herd. You have a persistent Kindred enemy who is richer and/or stronger than you.

entries.name: Bad Credit
entries.snippet: You start with 2 Debts owed to Kindred who have helped you before. You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** any Kindred who has been burned by you in the past.

entries.name: Bleeding Heart
entries.snippet: **If a mortal you've been romantically *Feeding* from is harmed, endangered, or killed**, mark 1 Stain and gain 1 Hunger.

entries.name: Breach of Contract
entries.snippet: A former client broke your pact and escaped. You have a persistent enemy who knows your methods and has warned others.

entries.name: Bunker Mentality
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** anyone you've known for less than a month.

entries.name: Catastrophic Secret
entries.snippet: **If your family or friends discover the full truth of what you are**, they become a 2-Debt liability until the situation is resolved.

entries.name: Catching Heat
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** law enforcement or anyone investigating violent crimes in your hunting grounds.

entries.name: Codependency
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* without your animal companion**, take -2 Forward. Feels bad without a buddy.

entries.name: Collateral Damage
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** anyone looking into service failures or missing workers in your area.

entries.name: Creature of Darkness
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Hunt** and **Feed** in well-lit or crowded areas.

entries.name: Crime Scene
entries.snippet: Your feasts always leave unmistakable evidence unless you have help and at least two hours to clean up. You start with 1 Debt owed to whoever cleaned up after your last one.

entries.name: Delayed Delivery
entries.snippet: Your animals take at least six hours to return with enough blood to slake 1 Hunger, and you can never slake more than 2 Hunger per night this way.

entries.name: Dependent
entries.snippet: You cannot use the **Hunt** Move yourself. You must rely on your allies to locate and deliver prey to you.

entries.name: Digital Breadcrumbs
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** anyone who investigates digital crimes or missing persons cases in your area.

entries.name: Ethical Spiral
entries.snippet: **If you *Feed* from someone who hasn't given genuine consent** (except in self-defense), mark 2 Stains and take -1 Ongoing until your next consensual **Feeding**. Stacks if violated repeatedly.

entries.name: Feed Me, Seymour
entries.snippet: **If you go more than 3 nights without tending your spawning pool**, one creature escapes, dies, or mutates, and the pool's output decreases until restored.

entries.name: Fixation
entries.snippet: **If your obsession target dies, moves away, or becomes permanently inaccessible**, mark 2 Stains and take -1 Ongoing to all rolls until you designate a new target (requires {{bp@min:1}} observation-only nights).

entries.name: High Maintenance
entries.snippet: You start with 3 Debts owed to suppliers or associates who help maintain your social calendar. At least one is doggedly pursuing repayment.

entries.name: Homebody
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* outside your chosen spot**, take -1 Forward. Why would you do this anywhere else?

entries.name: Insufferable Snob
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** anyone in the local arts community who disagrees with your assessments (AKA most of them).

entries.name: Invisible Locals
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Hunt** anyone who lives in your territory. Why would you eat your neighbors?

entries.name: Just A Sec!
entries.snippet: **When you and your Coterie *Sate Your Hunger***, take -1 Forward. Would you hurry up already?

entries.name: Known Trespasser
entries.snippet: You have -2 Ongoing to **Influence** any Kindred who manages or controls a Domain you've previously poached in.

entries.name: Legend Maintenance
entries.snippet: **If you go more than a few nights without reinforcing your folklore**, the offerings dry up until your legendary status is restored.

entries.name: Marked & Made
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to someone who knows your secret and could expose you.

entries.name: Mega-Methodical
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* or *Sate Your Hunger* without having observed your prey for at least 1 scene**, take -1 Forward.

entries.name: Mile Markers
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to someone who's helped you cover your tracks along your route.

entries.name: Missing Persons
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to someone who helped you cover up a botched abduction.

entries.name: Monstrous Appetite
entries.snippet: Your **Feeding** always leaves evidence unless you have at least an hour and a secure location. You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** vampires who know your diet but don't know you personally.

entries.name: Night Terrors
entries.snippet: **If you *Feed* from the same mortal more than twice**, they become a Masquerade risk at the Storyteller's discretion.

entries.name: Non-Confrontational
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from someone who is awake and aware of you**, take -1 Forward. It's really awkward.

entries.name: On the List
entries.snippet: A Hunter has your description and is actively looking for you. You have a persistent mortal enemy with training and resources to be a genuine threat.

entries.name: Parasitic Bond
entries.snippet: **If you are forced to abandon your current nesting site**, mark 1 Stain and take -1 Ongoing to **Hunt** and **Feed** until you establish a new nest (at least one week).

entries.name: Playing with Holy Fire
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to a religious figure who suspects what you are, or you have {{bp@min:1}} persistent enemies among the clergy.

entries.name: Public Figure
entries.snippet: **When you attempt to *Slip Away* or operate unnoticed in public spaces**, take -1 Forward. *Click!* OMG!

entries.name: Punching Up
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* or *Feed* from someone humble, powerless, or already broken**, take -1 Forward and slake 1 less Hunger.

entries.name: Resented Authority
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to a Kindred or faction who delivers your tribute but deeply resents the obligation.

entries.name: Sacred Ground
entries.snippet: **If your true nature is discovered by anyone in your congregation**, you lose access to them entirely until you establish a new flock (they panic and scatter).

entries.name: Scorned Diet
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* vampires who know about and judge your diet**, take -1 Ongoing until you exit the scene.

entries.name: Sensitive Stomach
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from someone genuinely virtuous or who has done no harm**, mark 1 Stain and roll +Resolve. **On a 6-**, you vomit their blood back up and regain any slaked Hunger.

entries.name: Sore Loser
entries.snippet: **If your rival *Feeds* from your co-target before you do**, take -1 Ongoing to **Feed** until your next successful **Hunt**.

entries.name: Stench of Death
entries.snippet: You have -2 Ongoing to **Influence** mortals in close proximity unless you've taken extensive measures to mask the smell.

entries.name: Stomach-Turning
entries.snippet: You have -3 Ongoing to **Influence** anyone who has watched you eat until at least a full week has passed.

entries.name: Surface Sickness
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** mortals in well-lit or open environments.

entries.name: Tangled Sheets & Hearts
entries.snippet: **Each time you *Feed* from the same person more than once**, they become increasingly attached. The Storyteller may introduce romantic complications or obsessive behavior.

entries.name: Taste for Tears
entries.snippet: **When you *Feed* from someone who isn't already upset, frightened, humiliated, or grieving**, take -1 Forward.

entries.name: The One That Got Away
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to someone helping you manage a loose end, or you have a persistent mortal enemy who knows your face.

entries.name: Tied to the Scene
entries.snippet: **When you *Hunt* outside your established scene**, take -1 Forward. Surely this could be easier.

entries.name: Under Scrutiny
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* medical staff, hospice workers, or investigators in your hunting grounds**, take -1 Ongoing.

entries.name: Unsettling Presence
entries.snippet: **When you *Influence* healthy, happy humans who don't know you well**, take -1 Ongoing.

entries.name: Usual Suspect
entries.snippet: You have -1 Ongoing to **Influence** event security, bouncers, or anyone responsible for guest management in your city.

entries.name: Vengeful Mark
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to someone helping you manage an escaped client, or you have a persistent enemy who knows your methods.

entries.name: Won't Happen Again
entries.snippet: You start with 1 Debt owed to someone connected to your blood source.
